question: Assume today is 2026-10-27. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate Equinor's total equity liquids and gas production in the third quarter of 2026, in barrels of oil equivalent per day (the report states it in thousand boe per day, mboe/d), as it will be first reported in Equinor's third quarter 2026 financial statements and review.

target.what: Equinor total equity liquids and gas production (combined oil, condensate, NGL and gas, on an equity basis) reported for Q3 2026, expressed as thousand barrels of oil equivalent per day
target.publisher: Equinor ASA (quarterly financial statements and review)
target.caveats: Target is the combined equity liquids+gas figure as first reported in Equinor's Q3 2026 report (typically published late October 2026). Working interpretation: total equity production of liquids and gas worldwide, in mboe/d, matching Equinor's headline 'Total equity production' line. Alternatives th

candidates.hypothesis: Equinor's total equity production in mboe/d follows a seasonal and portfolio trend; Q3 2026 can be anchored on Q3 2025 and recent quarters (Q4 2025, Q1 2026, Q2 2026) adjusted for known maintenance and portfolio changes. Target = prior-year same-quarter value plus net change from guidance/portfolio effects.
candidates.data_to_find: Equinor reported total equity production (mboe/d) for Q3 2025, Q4 2025, Q1 2026, Q2 2026, and any Q3 2026 preliminary/quarterly report if published before cutoff; also liquids vs gas split. Minimum: Q3 2025 and Q2 2026 totals.
search_hints: Equinor third quarter 2025 results total equity production mboe/d

candidates.perspective: Equinor management guidance and analyst consensus
candidates.hypothesis: Equinor issues annual production growth guidance (e.g., percent growth vs prior year) and capex/portfolio commentary; Q3 2026 can be derived by applying guided growth to the Q3 2025 base, with adjustments for maintenance seasonality. Consensus estimates from analysts approximate the reported figure.
candidates.data_to_find: Equinor 2026 production guidance (growth % or mboe/d range), any Q3 2026 trading update or preliminary production note, analyst consensus for Q3 2026 total production. Minimum: 2026 full-year growth guidance and Q3 2025 base.

candidates.hypothesis: Total equity production = sum over assets (Johan Sverdrup, Troll, Snorre, Gullfaks, Oseberg, Johan Castberg, international assets) of equity share × gross production. Known start-ups (Johan Castberg ramp), divestments, and maintenance outages in Q3 2026 shift the total; summing asset contributions constrains the aggregate.
candidates.data_to_find: Gross production and Equinor equity shares for major fields in Q3 2026; Johan Castberg ramp-up volumes; any announced divestments/acquisitions affecting Q3 2026; planned maintenance (turnarounds) on Norwegian Continental Shelf in Q3 2026. Minimum: Johan Castberg contribution and major turnaround schedule.

candidates.hypothesis: Equinor's equity production can be built from Norway (NCS) plus international segments; Norway dominates (~70%). Norway liquids+gas output from field-level or regulator data (Sokkeldirektoratet/Sodir) times Equinor equity share plus international segment gives total. Q3 2026 Norwegian gas exports and oil production provide a physical cross-check.
candidates.data_to_find: Norwegian total oil and gas production Q3 2026 (Sodir monthly), Equinor's share of NCS production, Equinor international segment production. Minimum: Norway Q3 2026 total and Equinor NCS share.

candidates.hypothesis: Q3 2026 production may deviate from trend due to unplanned outages (e.g., Hammerfest LNG, offshore strikes), weather, or OPEC+ quota effects on equity barrels. Identifying measurable disruptions adjusts the base estimate up or down.
candidates.data_to_find: Announced outages at Equinor-operated assets in Jul-Sep 2026 (Hammerfest LNG, Johan Sverdrup, Troll), strike/industrial action, and any force majeure; magnitude in boe/d and duration. Minimum: any single material outage with volume and days.

candidates.hypothesis: Total mboe/d = liquids (mb/d) + gas converted to boe (gas mboe/d). Equinor reports liquids and gas separately; the split and conversion (gas ~5.8 Mcf/boe or energy-based) let us reconstruct total from partial segment data or validate a total. Historical split ratios constrain the total if only one component is found.
candidates.data_to_find: Equinor Q3 2025 and recent liquids (mb/d) and gas (mboe/d or bcm/d) split; conversion factor used. Minimum: recent liquids/gas split and total.
search_hints: Equinor liquids gas production split mboe/d

methods.rationale: Anchors on the Q3 2025 actual (p1) and applies a YoY growth factor grounded in company 3% FY guidance and H1 6% delivered, with a range spanning the 4% Bloomberg consensus. Shared dependency: p1 is the base for m1 and m3; a1 and a3 both draw on the same guidance environment.

p31.role: H1 2026 production growth vs prior year (fraction)

methods.rationale: Uses the gap between H1 2026 delivered growth (6%) and FY guidance (3%) to infer H2 2026 growth of ~0% vs H2 2025, applied to the Q3 2025 base. Shared dependency: p1 with m1. Failure mode: H2 slowdown may be concentrated in Q4 rather than Q3.

Shared dependency: p16 and a2 with m2. Failure mode: double-counting if the drags are already embedded in the seasonal factor.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 YoY growth factor vs Q3 2025
assumptions.rationale: Company guidance of ~3% FY2026 growth (p12/p32/p84/p118/p132/p164/p194/p203/p238/p349/p362) and H1 2026 delivered 6% (p31/p127/p131/p166/p204/p358/p361) imply H2 must slow to ~0-1% to hit 3% FY; Q3 2025 base 2,130 (p1). Range spans 3% company guidance to 4% Bloomberg consensus (p133/p363) and the H1 pace.
assumptions.applies_when: Q3 2026 portfolio and maintenance resemble the FY2026 guidance environment.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence of a major unplanned outage or a step-change in new-field ramp that moves Q3 2026 well outside 0-7% YoY.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 seasonal factor vs Q2 2026
assumptions.rationale: Q3 2025 was 2,130 vs Q2 2025 2,096 = +1.6% (p1/p17); Q3 2024 1,984 vs Q2 2024 2,048 = -3.1% (p269/p270). Average ~-0.7% to +1.6%; use +1.6% central with a range covering both years.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence of a Q3 2026 maintenance or outage pattern materially different from prior Q3s.

assumptions.name: Q3 2026 net drag from Castberg outage and US/third-party turnarounds (mboe/d)
assumptions.rationale: Castberg ~14 mboe/d (p35/p125/p162/p199/p235/p350), US turnarounds ~25 mboe/d (p373), third-party-operated fields ~10 mboe/d (p371); sum ~49 mboe/d. Range reflects partial overlap and timing uncertainty.
assumptions.applies_when: These Q3 2026 drags are additive to the underlying run-rate.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that the drags overlap or that one is already embedded in the base quarter.

p1.role: Equinor total equity liquids and gas production Q3 2025 in mboe/d

a1.role: YoY growth factor for Q3 2026 vs Q3 2025

methods.rationale: Anchors on the Q3 2025 actual (p1) and applies a YoY growth factor grounded in company 3% FY guidance and H1 6% delivered, with a range spanning the 4% Bloomberg consensus. Shared dependency: p1 is the base for m1 and m3; a1 and a3 both draw on the same guidance environment.

methods.label: m2

p16.role: Equinor total equity production Q2 2026 in mboe/d

methods.rationale: Seasonal route from the latest actual quarter (p16) using the Q3/Q2 ratio observed in 2024-2025. Independent of the YoY route's base year. Failure mode: Q3 2026 maintenance or outage pattern differs from prior Q3s.

methods.label: m3

p1.role: Equinor total equity production Q3 2025 in mboe/d

p31.role: H1 2026 production growth vs prior year (fraction)

methods.rationale: Uses the gap between H1 2026 delivered growth (6%) and FY guidance (3%) to infer H2 2026 growth of ~0% vs H2 2025, applied to the Q3 2025 base. Shared dependency: p1 with m1. Failure mode: H2 slowdown may be concentrated in Q4 rather than Q3.

methods.label: m4

p16.role: Equinor total equity production Q2 2026 in mboe/d

a3.role: Q3 2026 net drag from Castberg outage and US/third-party turnarounds in mboe/d

methods.rationale: Seasonal route from Q2 2026 (p16) with an explicit deduction for the identified Q3 2026 drags (Castberg ~14, US turnarounds ~25, third-party ~10 mboe/d). Shared dependency: p16 and a2 with m2. Failure mode: double-counting if the drags are already embedded in the seasonal factor.

The best estimate for Equinor's total equity liquids and gas production in Q3 2026 (2026-07-01 to 2026-09-30), as first reported in its quarterly financial statements, is [[estimate]] [[unit]] ([[interval_level]] interval [[p10]] to [[p90]] [[unit]]).

The central route anchors on observed Q3 2025 production of [[p1_value]] and applies a YoY growth factor of [[a1_value]] (range [[a1_low]] to [[a1_high]]), grounded in company FY guidance of [[p32_value]] and H1 2026 delivered growth of [[p31_value]]. A seasonal route from observed Q2 2026 production of [[p16_value]] uses factor [[a2_value]] ([[a2_low]] to [[a2_high]]); a variant deducts [[a3_value]] [[unit]] ([[a3_low]] to [[a3_high]]) for Castberg, US and third-party drags. A third route infers H2 slowdown from the guidance-versus-H1 gap.

Observed inputs are the production points and growth figures; the growth, seasonal and drag factors are analyst assumptions. Code combined three blocks of overlapping methods at equal weight, taking the median; the interval is conditional on those assumptions, not a demonstrated accuracy guarantee. The main risk is that Q3 maintenance or the H2 slowdown timing differs from assumed. Actual Q3 field-level production and outage data would most improve it.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
